game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Merchant Waystation, a waystation for merchants: the scarab scholar must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Refactor Rescue: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior.
theme: Sand Dunes – Merchant Waystation: a waystation for merchants
core_gameplay_loop: In Merchant Waystation, repeat each round: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the clean_score value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about clean_score to power up the scarab scholar and open the sundial.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 4 (applied tier): Refactor Rescue
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Refactor Rescue' (Week 9 slot 8), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Merchant Waystation'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant scorpions in Merchant Waystation.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
